Package hadur117.core.duel

Class MoveDesign

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.duel.MoveDesign
final class MoveDesign extends Object
Duel-side switches for movement experiments; the move package never reads them.

    • RAM_BREAK

      static final boolean RAM_BREAK
      RAM-5: while RAM-2's escape drives, each path it weighs loses closest approach for every aim (head-on, linear) one of the rammer's shots in flight would hit it with. The 2026-10-28 rammer read (docs/bench/gap-to-2nd.md): against 12 nano rammers a linear aim would hit the escape on 52% of shots, Saguaro on 35%. On since pc-1v1-ram (PR #394): +0.11 ± 0.04 APS over 45 rammers.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • FLATTENER_OFF

      static final boolean FLATTENER_OFF
      MOVE-24: in a duel the flattener views stay off (3.15). The top-5 factorial (PR #221) put flattener off at +0.12 +/- 0.10 APS on 1,212 bots, and the release-candidate census (PR #222) put it with swall at +0.34 +/- 0.15. Melee and team are untouched.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • AIM_MEMBERS

      static final boolean AIM_MEMBERS
      MOVE-29 (K1 of the road to king, docs/bench/gun-oracle.md): the three-option surf's danger mixes the views' score with the head-on, linear and circular aims' (AimMembers), each member weighted by how well it predicted the bullets that hit us. Duel only. On from 3.20: pc-sg-aim +0.13 +- 0.07 APS on the 434 simple guns, pc-k1-aim +0.07 +- 0.15 on the 432 learning guns (docs/bench/simple-gun-gap.md).
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • AIM_INTERCEPTS

      static final boolean AIM_INTERCEPTS
      MOVE-30: with the aim members on, an enemy bullet our bullet met also scores the members (the views included, as member 0), as a hit does, without teaching the views. On for the next census (simple-gun dodge part 2, pc-sg-wide passed, PR #480); the ablation sgoff turns it off.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • MIMIC_MEMBERS

      static final boolean MIMIC_MEMBERS
      MOVE-33: with AIM_MEMBERS, the six visit-trained learning-gun mimics of MOVE-27 (GunMimics) join the aim members after the aims, sharing a standing weight of 0.3, each scored on the bullets as the aims are. BeepBoop's surf blends such mimics of named guns (docs/bench/gun-oracle.md). Duel only, off.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values
